extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from primary source sections/figures; generic scaffold claims about protein synthesis or nucleic acid interaction were removed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FITC-labeled TaARL6IP4 localizes to the plasma membrane of F. graminearum 5035 spores and inhibits spore germination rather than mycelial growth.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TaARL6IP4 peptide against Fusarium graminearum 5035 spores
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism claim is limited to F. graminearum spores under the reported fluorescence microscopy conditions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TaARL6IP4 disrupts F. graminearum spore membrane integrity, with PI uptake/flow cytometry and TEM evidence of concentration-associated membrane damage and cytoplasmic leakage.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct membrane-disruption evidence is reported for F. graminearum spores; broader fungal targets are not inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TaARL6IP4 binds deoxynivalenol in vitro with a reported KD of 91 ± 2.6 µM, while the GST control has much weaker affinity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GST-tagged TaARL6IP4 recombinant protein and DON
mechanism_claims.limitations: DON-binding evidence is a toxin-affinity result, not by itself an antimicrobial killing mechanism.
